The native clients were installed on Ubuntu, while the package-installed MCP server ran in Debian 12.

platform: Debian 12 amd64 disposable container, ordinary network disabled; installed server joined controlled route-free fixture namespace. Native clients ran on Ubuntu host.
repair: Initial slow mode failed before MCP handshake because the bridge unconditionally required a TLS fixture CA path, which is absent in HTTP-only mode. The bridge now copies and passes the CA only when supplied. Both native client replays and the default TLS regression then passed.
